sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Natalie Kittrowev.

sentences.en: Capitol Hill is still closed for business as the government shutdown heads into week two.
sentences.zh: 随着政府关门进入第二周，国会山依然闭门停业。

sentences.en: We're six days into the government shutdown and the Trump administration is capitalizing on the moment.
sentences.zh: 政府已经关门六天了，特朗普政府正在利用这个时机。

sentences.en: Far from working to end the shutdown, Donald Trump is using it as an excuse to ramp up his slash and burn cuts to the government.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普不仅没有努力结束关门，反而以此为借口，加剧对政府的大刀阔斧式削减。

sentences.en: By freezing billions of dollars in spending in cities and states run by Democrats and threatening to lay off thousands of government workers.
sentences.zh: 通过冻结民主党掌权州和城市的数十亿美元支出，并威胁解雇数千名政府工作人员。

sentences.en: So who is the man who appears to have the high trust of President Trump and gets to decide which federal workers will stay and which will go?
sentences.zh: 那么，这个似乎深受特朗普总统高度信任、并且能够决定哪些联邦员工去留的人究竟是谁？

sentences.en: The man at the center of that push to dismantle and reshape the American government.
sentences.zh: 这个处于拆解和重塑美国政府核心的人物。

sentences.en: Russell Vogt.
sentences.zh: 拉塞尔·沃格特。

sentences.en: Russell Vogt.
sentences.zh: 拉塞尔·沃格特。

sentences.en: Who is Russ Vogt?
sentences.zh: 拉塞尔·沃格特是谁？

sentences.en: Is White House Budget Director Russell Vogt.
sentences.zh: 正是白宫预算局局长拉塞尔·沃格特。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Coral Davenport explains how Vogt, a once obscure bureaucrat who worked on Project 2025, became one of the most influential figures in Washington.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事科勒·达文波特将解释沃格特这位曾参与“2025计划”的无名官僚，是如何成为华盛顿最有影响力的人物之一的。

sentences.en: It's Monday, October 6th.
sentences.zh: 今天是10月6日，星期一。

sentences.en: Coral, Russell Vogt is someone I've generally been aware of.
sentences.zh: 科勒，我对拉塞尔·沃格特这个人大致有所耳闻。

sentences.en: But right now, because of the shutdown, he has taken on much more of a protagonist role in the Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 但现在，由于政府关门，他在特朗普政府中扮演了更为核心的角色。

sentences.en: Everyone seems to be talking about him.
sentences.zh: 每个人似乎都在谈论他。

sentences.en: So just to start, who is Russ Vogt?
sentences.zh: 所以首先，拉塞尔·沃格特究竟是谁？

sentences.en: So Russ Vogt is the director of the White House Office of Management and Budget, which is normally a pretty wonky role.
sentences.zh: 拉塞尔·沃格特是白宫管理和预算办公室主任，这个职位通常非常务实且偏向技术细节。

sentences.en: But at this moment in the shutdown, he has really taken center stage.
sentences.zh: 但在这次政府关门期间，他确实成为了全场的焦点。

sentences.en: He has had this plan to cut the government, cut spending, cut agencies, cut workers.
sentences.zh: 他一直有个计划，要削减政府、削减开支、削减机构、削减员工。

sentences.en: And now is kind of Russ Vogt's time to shine to do that.
sentences.zh: 现在正是拉塞尔·沃格特大显身手、实现这一切的时候。

sentences.en: And we've seen that this week as Democrats have painted him as this villain in the shutdown scenario.
sentences.zh: 我们本周也看到了这一点，民主党人在政府关门事件中把他刻画成了一个恶人。

sentences.en: And even Senate Republican leader John Thune said, we don't even know what this guy's going to do.
sentences.zh: 甚至参议院共和党领袖约翰·图恩也说，我们甚至不知道这家伙要做什么。

sentences.en: And sort of most spectacularly of all, the president posted this video of Russ Vogt as the Grim Reaper.
sentences.zh: 最戏剧性的一幕是，总统发布了一段视频，把拉塞尔·沃格特塑造成了死神。

sentences.en: So in this video, you see Vogt as literally the Grim Reaper striding in front of the Capitol and Trump on the cowbell.
sentences.zh: 在这段视频里，你可以看到沃格特简直就像死神一样大步走在国会大厦前，而特朗普则在敲着牛铃。

sentences.en: They sing like, now the time has come, their power's gone, he ties your hands, Russ wields
sentences.zh: 他们唱着，现在时机已到，你们的权力已失，他束缚你们的双,手，拉塞尔挥舞着

sentences.en: the pen, the funds and the brain.
sentences.zh: 笔、资金和大脑。

sentences.en: You know, this video is nuts, but it's also sort of the core of it is really accurate.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这段视频太疯狂了，但它的核心其实非常准确。

sentences.en: In so many ways, that's what's going on right now.
sentences.zh: 在很多方面，这正是现在正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: The plan that Russ Vogt has been putting in place is about taking power away from Congress,
sentences.zh: 拉塞尔·沃格特正在实施的计划，就是要剥夺国会的权力，

sentences.en: tying the hands of Congress, bringing the power over to the White House, to the president.
sentences.zh: 束缚国会的手脚，把权力转移到白宫，转移到总统手中。

sentences.en: So, you know, it's like this crazy Internet meme that is kind of spot on.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，这就像是一个疯狂的网络迷因，却又恰到好处。

sentences.en: OK, so setting aside the question of whether we can fact check the AI imagery in this truly wild video, you're saying it accurately assesses Vogt's role.
sentences.zh: 好吧，抛开我们是否能对这个极其疯狂的视频中的AI图像进行事实核查的问题不谈，你是说它准确评估了沃格特的角色。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: I mean, normally, the role of the White House budget director is just this very kind of behind
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，通常情况下，白宫预算局局长的工作是非常幕后的，

sentences.en: the scenes job that's really about taking the president's policy agenda and translating it into a budget.
sentences.zh: 主要负责将总统的政策议程转化为预算。

sentences.en: Vogt does far more than that.
sentences.zh: 但沃格特做的事远不止于此。

sentences.en: He is really using the role as an agenda setter itself.
sentences.zh: 他实际上是将这个职位当作一个议程设定器来使用。

sentences.en: He has spent years preparing this vision for the entire federal government.
sentences.zh: 他花了好几年时间为整个联邦政府制定这一愿景。

sentences.en: And I should say, this comes from a place of thinking of the federal bureaucracy as something that is deeply problematic.
sentences.zh: 我必须指出，这源于一种将联邦政府官僚机构视为严重问题根源的视角。

sentences.en: He calls it woke and weaponized.
sentences.zh: 他称其为“觉醒”且被武器化的机构。

sentences.en: And he really thinks that the federal government is the problem.
sentences.zh: 他真心认为联邦政府本身就是问题所在。

sentences.en: And I should say another thing that comes up in my reporting a lot is the word nerd.
sentences.zh: 我还要说的是，在我的报道中经常出现的一个词是“书呆子”。

sentences.en: He really is this, like, hard-working policy nerd who has focused his whole career on this objective of smaller government with less spending and less workers.
sentences.zh: 他确实是一个这样的人，一个极其努力的政策书呆子，他把整个职业生涯都专注于实现一个目标：打造一个开支更少、员工更少的小政府。

sentences.en: He's such a true believer.
sentences.zh: 他是个如此坚定的信徒。

sentences.en: He even named his dog Milton for Milton Friedman, the free market economiSt.
sentences.zh: 他甚至用自由市场经济学家米尔顿·弗Friedman的名字给自己的狗命名为米尔顿。

sentences.en: And now he has met this moment of shrinking federal government.
sentences.zh: 现在他迎来了精简联邦政府的这一刻。

sentences.en: OK, you described him as a true believer.
sentences.zh: 好的，你把他形容为一个坚定的信徒。

sentences.en: How does he arrive at those beliefs?
sentences.zh: 他是如何形成这些信念的？

sentences.en: How does he get to where he is now on this mission to radically change the shape of government?
sentences.zh: 他是如何走到今天这一步，踏上彻底改变政府形态的使命的？

sentences.en: Natalie, I have spent weeks and weeks of reporting trying to get at that.
sentences.zh: 娜塔莉，我花了整整好几周的报道时间来探究这一点。

sentences.en: And I should say that Russ Vogt did not grant me an interview for this piece.
sentences.zh: 我必须说明，拉塞尔·沃格特并没有接受我的采访来做这篇报道。

sentences.en: But I have read hundreds of pages of his writings.
sentences.zh: 但我读了他几百页的著作。

sentences.en: I've listened to hours and hours of his podcasts.
sentences.zh: 我听了他数小时的播客。

sentences.en: I talked to between 30 and 40 people who are kind of in his orbit and have worked with him and know him and are his friends.
sentences.zh: 我采访了大约30到40名在他周围、与他共事过、了解他并且是他的朋友的人。

sentences.en: And what kind of came up is someone who really has believed this for a very, very long time.
sentences.zh: 得出的结论是，他是一个非常、非常长久以来就坚信这一点的人。

sentences.en: I have spent my entire career caring about taxpayers and families.
sentences.zh: 我整个职业生涯都在关心纳税人和家庭。

sentences.en: He talked about that in his very first Senate confirmation hearing.
sentences.zh: 他在第一次参议院听证会上就谈到了这一点。

sentences.en: I come from a blue-collar family.
sentences.zh: 我出身于一个蓝领家庭。

sentences.en: I'm the son of an electrician and a public school teacher.
sentences.zh: 我是一个电工和公立学校老师的儿子。

sentences.en: He grew up in a conservative, religious, blue-collar family.
sentences.zh: 他在一个保守、宗教色彩浓厚的蓝领家庭长大。

sentences.en: He is the youngest of seven children.
sentences.zh: 他是七个孩子中最小的一个。

sentences.en: Grew up in Trumbull, Connecticut.
sentences.zh: 在康涅狄格州特朗布尔长大。

sentences.en: His father, interestingly, was a union electrician and he was a Marine Corps veteran.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，他的父亲是一名工会电工，也是一名海军陆战队退伍军人。

sentences.en: His mother was a public school teacher.
sentences.zh: 他的母亲是一名公立学校老师。

sentences.en: In both of those cases, you know, I don't think of that as being something that would lead you into trying to work to minimize government.
sentences.zh: 在这两种情况下，你知道，我不认为这会引导你试图去努力尽量减少政府。

sentences.en: But he has described how his parents worked incredibly hard to support him and his siblings.
sentences.zh: 但他描述过他的父母是如何极其努力地工作来养活他和他的兄弟姐妹的。

sentences.en: I know what they went through to balance their budget and save for the future.
sentences.zh: 我知道他们为了平衡预算和为未来存钱经历了什么。

sentences.en: My parents worked really long hours to put me through school, but they also worked long hours to pay for the high levels of government in their own life.
sentences.zh: 我的父母工作时间非常长，供我上学，但他们也长时间工作，来支付他们生活中高昂的政府税收成本。

sentences.en: I think he really genuinely sees the burden of paying for taxes in government as weighing so heavily on families like his own.
sentences.zh: 我想他真的是由衷地认为，为政府税收买单的负担对像他自己这样的家庭来说太沉重了。

sentences.en: My old boss called them the wagon pullers in our country.
sentences.zh: 我的老老板称他们为我们国家的“拉车人”。

sentences.en: Others have referred to them as the forgotten men and women.
sentences.zh: 其他人则称他们为被遗忘的男人和女人。

sentences.en: They have always been my test for federal spending.
sentences.zh: 他们一直是我衡量联邦开支的标准。

sentences.en: Did a particular program or spending increase help the nameless wagon pullers across our country working hard at their job,
sentences.zh: 某个特定的项目或开支增加，是否真的帮助了全国各地那些默默无闻、努力工作、

sentences.en: trying to provide for their family and future without the luxury of watching C-SPAN at that particular moment to know that we might increase their burden at that minute?
sentences.zh: 试图养家糊口并为未来奋斗的拉车人？而他们当时并没有奢侈地坐在那里看C-SPAN电视转播，去知道我们可能在那一分钟增加了他们的负担。

sentences.en: It sounds like he was kind of turned against the idea of big government from the very beginning as a child seeing his parents navigate this country.
sentences.zh: 听起来他从小看着父母在这个国家奔波，从一开始就对大政府的想法产生了抵触。

sentences.en: Yeah, and you really see that through line.
sentences.zh: 是的，你确实能看到这条清晰的脉络。

sentences.en: You know, as soon as he graduated college, he went straight to Washington and got a job working for Senator Phil Graham,
sentences.zh: 你知道，他一大学毕业就直接去了华盛顿，在得克萨斯州共和党参议员菲尔·格拉姆手下找到了一份工作，

sentences.en: a Texas Republican who was at the time known as this icon of fiscal conservatism, fiscal austerity.
sentences.zh: 菲尔·格拉姆当时被称为财政保守主义和财政紧缩的标志性人物。

sentences.en: And I talked to Phil Graham about rest vote, and he said something interesting.
sentences.zh: 我和菲尔·格拉姆谈过关于拉塞尔·沃格特的事，他说了一件很有趣的事。

sentences.en: He said, usually, you know, people come to work for me because they really want to come and work for me.
sentences.zh: 他说，通常情况下，你知道，人们来为我工作是因为他们真的很想来为我工作。

sentences.en: You know, that they are really sort of driven by this idea of slashing government.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们确实是受到削减政府这种想法的驱动。

sentences.en: And I asked him, you know, what he remembered about rest vote.
sentences.zh: 我问他，你知道，他还记得拉塞尔·沃格特的什么事。

sentences.en: And he said he remembered him as almost working too hard.
sentences.zh: 他说他记得拉塞尔工作起来几乎到了拼命的地步。

sentences.en: You know, working by day to support the agenda of cutting government and then going to law school at night.
sentences.zh: 你知道，白天工作以支持削减政府的议程，晚上还要去读法学院。

sentences.en: So it's passion that's combined with this really intense work ethic.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一种激情，与极其强烈的工作伦理相结合。

sentences.en: Passion plus discipline.
sentences.zh: 激情加纪律。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是的。

sentences.en: So after Phil Graham, he goes to work for the House Republicans.
sentences.zh: 所以在菲尔·格拉姆之后，他去为众议院共和党人工作。

sentences.en: He focuses on budget policy.
sentences.zh: 他专注于预算政策。

sentences.en: This is kind of during the time of the rise of the Tea Party movement.
sentences.zh: 这正值茶党运动兴起的时期。

sentences.en: So there's this wave of intense fiscal conservatism, anti-government sweeping through Washington.
sentences.zh: 因此，当时有一股强烈的财政保守主义和反政府浪潮席卷华盛顿。

sentences.en: And he's a natural fit with all of that.
sentences.zh: 而这一切与他自然契合。

sentences.en: And then he goes from there to the Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 然后他从那里加入了特朗普政府。

sentences.en: But I should say, it wasn't necessarily an automatic fit for him.
sentences.zh: 但我必须说，这对他来说并不一定是不谋而合的自然契合。

sentences.en: You know, one way that rest vote is very different from President Trump is he's very religious.
sentences.zh: 你知道，拉塞尔·沃格特与特朗普总统非常不同的一点在于，他非常虔诚。

sentences.en: He takes his faith really seriously.
sentences.zh: 他非常严肃地对待自己的信仰。

sentences.en: He teaches adult Bible study at his church.
sentences.zh: 他在自己的教堂里教成年人圣经学习班。

sentences.en: And before joining the first Trump administration, he actually thought about kind of leaving the world of Washington policy.
sentences.zh: 在加入第一届特朗普政府之前，他甚至考虑过离开华盛顿的政策世界。

sentences.en: And going to seminary and studying to be a pastor.
sentences.zh: 去神学院学习并成为一名牧师。

sentences.en: The rest vote doesn't curse.
sentences.zh: 拉塞尔·沃格特从不诅咒说脏话。

sentences.en: President Trump has a foul mouth.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统则满嘴脏话。

sentences.en: He refers to Christians in the third person.
sentences.zh: 他用第三人称来指代基督徒。

sentences.en: I think just culturally there was some discomfort with that fit.
sentences.zh: 我认为仅从文化角度来看，这种契合度确实存在一些不适感。

sentences.en: But in the end, the call of the White House won out and he joins the first Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 但最终，白宫的召唤战胜了这一切，他加入了第一届特朗普政府。

sentences.en: He's there from the very beginning.
sentences.zh: 他从一开始就在那里。

sentences.en: And what does he do in that first Trump term?
sentences.zh: 他在第一届特朗普任期内做了什么？

sentences.en: Washington has a spending problem.
sentences.zh: 华盛顿存在开支问题。

sentences.en: And it endangers the future prosperity of our nation for generations to come.
sentences.zh: 这危及了我们国家未来几代人的繁荣。

sentences.en: So he enters the first Trump administration as deputy budget chief.
sentences.zh: 因此，他作为副预算局长进入了第一届特朗普政府。

sentences.en: By the end, he's running the whole office.
sentences.zh: 到最后，他掌管了整个办公室。

sentences.en: During that time, he argued that the president had the power to block federal spending that Congress had approved.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，他认为总统有权阻止国会批准的联邦开支。

sentences.en: And we are saying to the American people, we can no longer afford the paradigm that Congress keeps giving us,
sentences.zh: 我们正在对美国人民说，我们再也负担不起国会不断给我们的这种模式了，

sentences.en: which is that we're never going to make any tradeoffs, that we're never going to align what we spend with what we take in.
sentences.zh: 那就是我们永远不会做出任何权衡，我们永远不会将我们的支出与我们的收入相匹配。

sentences.en: And he tried to do that in a number of really memorable cases.
sentences.zh: 他在一些非常难忘的案例中试图这样做。

sentences.en: Breaking news.
sentences.zh: 突发新闻。

sentences.en: President Trump reportedly ordered to hold back military aid for Ukraine for at leaSt...
sentences.zh: 据报道，特朗普总统下令至少暂缓对乌克兰的军事援助……

sentences.en: He was part of a group of White House officials who froze military spending for Ukraine in defiance of Congress.
sentences.zh: 他是无视国会、冻结对乌克兰军事开支的白宫官员小组的成员之一。

sentences.en: Listeners will probably remember that that essentially paved a way to the president's impeachment.

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky.

sentences.en: And I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我每天都负责创作《拼写蜜蜂》（Spelling Bee）和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做联觉（promesthesia）的特性。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.

sentences.en: Coral, you said vote all ready to go runs into Elon Musk.
sentences.zh: 科拉，你刚才说万事俱备的沃特碰上了埃隆·马斯克。

sentences.en: What did you mean by that?
sentences.zh: 你这话是什么意思？

sentences.en: Well, Musk had contributed more than any other donor toward the re-election of President Trump.
sentences.zh: 嗯，马斯克为特朗普总统的竞选连任捐款比任何其他捐赠者都多。

sentences.en: He's the richest man in the world.
sentences.zh: 他是世界上最富有的人。

sentences.en: And, of course, he came in with this idea of what would become Doge, this move fast and break things, tear up the federal government.
sentences.zh: 当然，他带着后来成为“政府效率部”（Doge）的想法入场，即快速行动、打破常规、彻底拆散联邦政府。

sentences.en: And vote very much had his vision.
sentences.zh: 而沃特也有着他自己的愿景。

sentences.en: They both envisioned, you know, clearing out all the inefficiencies and streamlining the government.
sentences.zh: 他们俩都设想过要清除所有效率低下的环节并精简政府。

sentences.en: But beyond that, the practice of how, in fact, to do it was profoundly different.
sentences.zh: 但除此之外，具体该如何操作的做法却有着天壤之别。

sentences.en: How so?
sentences.zh: 怎么说？

sentences.en: Because it does seem like the two might be rowing in the same direction, being kind of philosophically aligned on this issue.
sentences.zh: 因为看起来这两个人在哲学理念上是一致的，似乎是在朝着同一个方向划桨。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: But, you know, the way one person put it to me is, like, vote did all his homework.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，正如一个人对我形容的那样：沃特做完了所有的功课。

sentences.en: Musk did not do it at all.
sentences.zh: 而马斯克压根没做。

sentences.en: You know, vote had to be brought in to help brief Musk on how the government works.
sentences.zh: 你知道，还得把沃特请来，帮马斯克恶补政府是如何运作的。

sentences.en: And Musk came in and he had all this money and he had access to the president.
sentences.zh: 而马斯克来的时候带着大笔资金，并且能接触到总统。

sentences.en: And he was kind of given free reign to do what he wanted.
sentences.zh: 他基本上获得了自由裁量权来做他想做的事。

sentences.en: And in many ways, at least at the beginning, vote was not sort of in the center.
sentences.zh: 在很多方面，至少在刚开始时，沃特并没有处于核心地位。

sentences.en: He was kind of sidelined.
sentences.zh: 他有点被边缘化了。

sentences.en: He was extremely frustrated.
sentences.zh: 他感到极其沮丧。

sentences.en: And what Musk was doing drove vote crazy.
sentences.zh: 马斯克的所作所为把沃特气疯了。

sentences.en: Can you give us an example just of what the kind of frustration of vote actually looked like?
sentences.zh: 你能给我们举个例子，说明沃特究竟感到了怎样的沮丧吗？

sentences.en: I mean, when did Musk get in his way?
sentences.zh: 我是说，马斯克是什么时候碍他的事的？

sentences.en: How exactly?
sentences.zh: 具体是怎么回事？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: So early on in the Doge era, Doge informed all federal employees that every Friday they had to send an email listing five things that they had accomplished that week.
sentences.zh: 在“政府效率部”时期的早期，Doge通知所有联邦雇员，他们必须在每周五发送一电子邮件，列出他们那周完成的五项工作。

sentences.en: But the basic process by which that email had been sent out was not legal.
sentences.zh: 但发送该电子邮件的基本程序并不合法。

sentences.en: And there's a lot of federal agencies where people work on things that cannot be publicly disclosed.
sentences.zh: 许多联邦机构里的人都在从事不能公开披露的工作。

sentences.en: You know, it's the kind of thing you could probably send out in a private company.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这在私企里可能发出去也就发出去了。

sentences.en: But in the federal government, it set off all these legal tripwires, caused all these probleMs.
sentences.zh: 但在联邦政府里，它触动了所有的法律警戒线，引发了各种问题。

sentences.en: And crucially, what Doge was doing was sparking off a lot of litigation that vote did not want and had not planned.
sentences.zh: 最关键的是，Doge的做法引发了大量的诉讼，这是沃特不想要也未曾计划过的。

sentences.en: Vote wants litigation.
sentences.zh: 沃特才想要诉讼呢。

sentences.en: He wants lawsuits.
sentences.zh: 他想要的是诉讼。

sentences.en: But he has a very specific roadmap of exactly how he wants those lawsuits to go.
sentences.zh: 但他有一套非常具体的路线图，确切地知道他希望这些诉讼如何进行。

sentences.en: The Doge was just like breaking stuff and cutting stuff all over the place, doing things that vote knew were illegal and were causing all this litigation that he didn't even want.
sentences.zh: 狗狗币团队就像是在到处砸东西、砍预算，做一些投票明知是非法的事情，并引发了所有这些他甚至并不想要的诉讼。

sentences.en: It's interesting.
sentences.zh: 这很有意思。

sentences.en: You hear a lot that the Trump administration, you know, has tried to do this flood the zone approach
sentences.zh: 你经常听到有人说，特朗普政府采取了这种所谓的“饱和轰炸”方法，

sentences.en: of overwhelm your opponents with so many things that they just can't contend with them all.
sentences.zh: 即用大量的事情压倒你的对手，让他们根本应接不暇。

sentences.en: But vote is really advocating the opposite, it sounds like.
sentences.zh: 但听起来，沃特实际上在主张截然相反的做法。

sentences.en: I mean, he is wanting a very deliberate plan to be executed.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他希望执行一个非常深思熟虑的计划。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: He is the consummate disciplined executor.
sentences.zh: 他是那种极其具有纪律性的执行者。

sentences.en: In every way, the opposite, I think, of how Musk operates.
sentences.zh: 在各个方面，这可以说是马斯克行事风格的对立面。

sentences.en: And that's why once Musk finally blew up with the president and left town, that really is where we have seen the rise of WrestleVote.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，当马斯克终于与总统闹翻并离开华盛顿后，这正是我们看到“摔跤沃特”崛起的时刻。

sentences.en: And what has that rise actually looked like?
sentences.zh: 这种崛起实际上是什么样子的？

sentences.en: What's the manifestation of vote unleashed, unencumbered by Musk?
sentences.zh: 当沃特被彻底释放、不再受马斯克束缚时，会有怎样的表现？

sentences.en: So as soon as Musk leaves, you start to see vote enact this stepwise approach to legally locking down a lot of the cuts that he wants to put into place.
sentences.zh: 因此，就在马斯克离开后，你开始看到沃特采取这种循序渐进的方法，从法律上锁定了许多他想要落实的预算削减。

sentences.en: First out, he sends this request to Congress saying, hey, I want you to cut about $8 billion in foreign aid that we don't want to spend, that you've already appropriated.
sentences.zh: 首先，他向国会发送了一份请求，说：嘿，我希望你们削减大约80亿美元我们不想花、而你们已经拨款的对外援助。

sentences.en: Congress is very uncomfortable with this.
sentences.zh: 国会对这感到非常不安。

sentences.en: Even a lot of Republicans are very uncomfortable with this.
sentences.zh: 甚至许多共和党人也对此感到非常不安。

sentences.en: So what vote does is he inserts in that package something that he thinks that will make it irresistible to his fellow conservatives.
sentences.zh: 因此，沃特采取的做法是，在该一揽子计划中加入了一项他认为会让其保守派同僚无法抗拒的内容。

sentences.en: The proposal would rescind $1.1 billion in funding to the Corporation for Public Broadcasting.
sentences.zh: 该提议将取消对公共广播公司的11亿美元资助。

sentences.en: Which is cuts to the Corporation for Public Broadcasting.
sentences.zh: 也就是对公共广播公司的削减。

sentences.en: Which has funded a politically biased public media system that has promoted radical and divisive ideologies at the American taxpayer's expense.
sentences.zh: 该公司资助了一个政治倾向偏颇的公共媒体系统，以美国纳税人为代价宣传激进和分裂的意识形态。

sentences.en: And that strategy ends up working.
sentences.zh: 而这一策略最终奏效了。

sentences.en: On this vote, the yeas are 216.
sentences.zh: 在这项投票中，赞成票为216票。

sentences.en: The nays are 213.
sentences.zh: 反对票为213票。

sentences.en: The resolution is adopted.
sentences.zh: 决议获得通过。

sentences.en: And vote gloated about this.
sentences.zh: 沃特为此沾沾自喜。

sentences.en: We've talked about defunding Corporation for Public Broadcasting for decades.
sentences.zh: 我们几十年来一直在讨论停止资助公共广播公司。

sentences.en: President Trump's the first one to be able to do it.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统是第一个能够做到这一点的人。

sentences.en: He said, we budgeteers, we conservatives have tried for years and years to kill the Corporation for Public Broadcasting.
sentences.zh: 他说，我们这些预算制定者、我们这些保守派，多年来一直试图消灭公共广播公司。

sentences.en: And now we've finally done it.
sentences.zh: 现在我们终于做到了。

sentences.en: So then he escalates this idea of taking the power of the purse from Congress.
sentences.zh: 于是，他进一步升级了这种从国会手中夺取财政权的想法。

sentences.en: Today, the president and Russ Vogt sent over to Congress a pocket of about $5 billion in rescissions.
sentences.zh: 今天，总统和拉塞尔·沃特向国会提交了一揽子总额约50亿美元的资金收回计划。

sentences.en: And what he said is, look, we have about another $5 billion in foreign aid that you, Congress, have appropriated that we don't want to spend.
sentences.zh: 他说的是，看吧，我们还有大约50亿美元的对外援助，是你们国会已经拨款但我们不想花的。

sentences.en: And it's not just $5 billion.
sentences.zh: 而且这不仅仅是50亿美元。

sentences.en: It's $5 billion of the absolute worst examples of foreign aid.
sentences.zh: 这是对外援助中最糟糕的50亿美元的典型例子。

sentences.en: We're not going to spend it.
sentences.zh: 我们不打算花这笔钱。

sentences.en: We're going to cancel it.
sentences.zh: 我们要将其取消。

sentences.en: Unless you vote otherwise by the end of the fiscal year, which is September 30th.
sentences.zh: 除非你们在9月30日财年结束前投票做出不同的决定。

sentences.en: Kind of daring them to do this.
sentences.zh: 这有点像是在挑衅他们这么做。

sentences.en: Daring them to vote against him.
sentences.zh: 挑衅他们投反对票。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But they didn't do it.
sentences.zh: 但他们并没有这么做。

sentences.en: And so, essentially, that allows the White House to kind of roll over them and say, all right, that money is now canceled.
sentences.zh: 所以，从本质上讲，这使得白宫能够压倒他们并表示：好吧，这笔钱现在取消了。

sentences.en: There is this congressional watchdog agency, the Government Accountability Office, that says this is absolutely illegal.
sentences.zh: 国会有一个名为政府问责局的监督机构，该机构认为这绝对是非法的。

sentences.en: And what I have been told by people close to vote is that he would like to see them sue.
sentences.zh: 接近沃特的人士告诉我，他很想看到他们提起诉讼。

sentences.en: That that's like a lawsuit that he wants to have and take to the Supreme Court because he is so confident that he will win.
sentences.zh: 这是他想要进行并一直打到最高法院的诉讼，因为他极其确信自己会赢。

sentences.en: So it sounds like, in this case, vote has basically gone to Congress and said, look, we're not going to spend this $5 billion in foreign aid that you've already appropriated.
sentences.zh: 所以听起来，在这种情况下，沃特基本上对国会说：听着，你们已经拨款的这50亿美元对外援助，我们不打算花了。

sentences.en: Go ahead and challenge us on it.
sentences.zh: 有本事就来挑战我们吧。

sentences.en: Congress does not challenge the Trump administration on this.
sentences.zh: 国会并未就此对特朗普政府提出挑战。

sentences.en: And now he's waiting and wanting this watchdog office to bring a legal challenge because this is a way to get the Supreme Court to rule on the issue he cares most about,
sentences.zh: 现在他在等待并希望这个监督机构发起法律挑战，因为这是让最高法院对一个他最关心的问题做出裁决的途径，

sentences.en: which is impoundment, basically the ability of the president to not spend money that Congress has directed him to spend.
sentences.zh: 即资金扣留权，也就是总统有权不花国会指示他花的钱。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And, you know, I can't say that this is going to be the exact vehicle,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我不能说这就是最终的具体方式，

sentences.en: but they are definitely trying to line up these cases and kind of line up these moments where they are intentionally pushing against what is seen as the lines of the law in order to engineer such a Supreme Court case.
sentences.zh: 但他们确实在努力排兵布阵这些案件，并刻意制造这样的时刻：他们故意冲撞法律的边缘，从而促成这样一个最高法院案件。

sentences.en: Coral, I want to zoom out and just ask you a question that I've been thinking of as we've been discussing votes aiMs.
sentences.zh: 科拉，我想把视线拉远一点，问你一个在我讨论沃特的目标时一直在思考的问题。

sentences.en: Is there not a risk that all this work he's done to empower the executive could just make it even easier for the next president to do exactly what Biden did last time,
sentences.zh: 难道不存在这样一种风险吗：他为增强行政部门权力所做的所有这些工作，反而会让下一任总统更容易去完全复制拜登上次做的事，

sentences.en: overturn a bunch of this stuff and undo all of votes work?
sentences.zh: 推翻其中一大堆东西，并撤销沃特的所有工作？

sentences.en: Like, what's to stop a powerful Democratic president from just turning back on these spigots that he's turned off?
sentences.zh: 比如，有什么能阻止一个强有力的民主党总统重新打开那些被他关闭的水龙头呢？

sentences.en: Great question.
sentences.zh: 问得好。

sentences.en: And he's definitely thought about this and he's talked about this.
sentences.zh: 他确实考虑过这一点，也讨论过这一点。

sentences.en: We can actually save the country.
sentences.zh: 我们实际上可以拯救这个国家。

sentences.en: And that's really what it comes down to.
sentences.zh: 这才是真正的关键所在。

sentences.en: The hour's late.
sentences.zh: 时间已经不多了。

sentences.en: It's not too late, but it's really late.
sentences.zh: 虽然还为时不晚，但确实很晚了。

sentences.en: He understands the people who he's working with very much understand that they're not going to stay in power, that they have a limited amount of time to do what they want to do.
sentences.zh: 他深知——与他合作的人也非常清楚——他们不可能永远掌权，他们做想做的事的时间是有限的。

sentences.en: If we don't execute, we may never have this chance again.
sentences.zh: 如果我们不付诸行动，我们可能再也不会有这样的机会了。

sentences.en: So creating something permanent is the ultimate aim.
sentences.zh: 因此，创造持久的东西是最终的目标。

sentences.en: And so the way that vote has described this is once they can kind of re-engineer presidential power to cut off spending to agencies and programs,
sentences.zh: 沃特对这一点的描述是，一旦他们能够重新设计总统权力以切断对机构和项目的开支，

sentences.en: the idea is basically starve them to death.
sentences.zh: 其思路基本上就是让他们饿死。

sentences.en: We want to make sure that the bureaucracy can't reconstitute itself later in future administrations.
sentences.zh: 我们要确保官僚机构在未来的政府中无法自行重组。

sentences.en: Cut off spending to foreign aid, to the Environmental Protection Agency, to agencies like the Federal Reserve.
sentences.zh: 切断对对外援助、环境保护局以及美联储等机构的开支。

sentences.en: Cut off all this spending so profoundly that even if, you know, a very liberal Democrat president comes in after Trump leaves,
sentences.zh: 如此彻底地切断所有这些开支，以至于即便在特朗普离任后上来一位非常自由派的民主党总统，

sentences.en: these agencies aren't just slimmed down or, you know, somewhat deprived of resources.
sentences.zh: 这些机构也不仅仅是被精简或者说被剥夺了一部分资源。

sentences.en: They've basically been scorched down to nothing.
sentences.zh: 它们基本上已经被烧得灰烬不剩。

sentences.en: And the idea is that it would need a generation or more for them to come back, that just turning on the spigots would not be enough to bring them back.
sentences.zh: 这个想法是，它们需要整整一代人或更长的时间才能恢复，仅仅打开水龙头已经不足以让它们复活了。

sentences.en: The picture that you've described here, Coral, is one where you have an incredibly meticulous planner,
sentences.zh: 科拉，你这里描述的画面是一个拥有极其细致规划者的画面，

sentences.en: motivated and empowered to carry out a pretty radical vision.
sentences.zh: 他们充满动力且被赋予权力去实现一个相当激进的愿景。

sentences.en: And I wonder if we consider what it would look like for vote to carry this all the way through, for his vision to be fully realized.
sentences.zh: 我在想，如果我们设想一下沃特一路贯彻到底、其愿景完全实现会是什么样子。

sentences.en: How do the contours of the American government change in a world where he really implements his plan to the fullest?
sentences.zh: 在一个他真正将计划全面落地的世界里，美国政府的轮廓会发生怎样的变化？

sentences.en: So, vote has described how he thinks this would look.
sentences.zh: 因此，沃特已经描述过他认为这会是什么样子。

sentences.en: If you have a radical constitutionalism, and that's really what I've been calling for, given this crazy unconstitutional situation that we're finding ourselves in,
sentences.zh: 如果你拥有激进的宪政主义——鉴于我们当前发现自己处于这种疯狂的违宪状态，这正是我一直呼吁的——

sentences.en: if you have a radical constitutionalism, it's going to be destabilizing.
sentences.zh: 如果你拥有激进的宪政主义，它将带来不稳定。

sentences.en: He would call it radical constitutionalism.
sentences.zh: 他会称之为激进的宪政主义。

sentences.en: He would say that he is trying to create a world that is what the founding fathers wanted.
sentences.zh: 他会说他正在努力创造一个符合国父们意愿的世界。

sentences.en: There are no independent agencies.
sentences.zh: 将不再有独立机构。

sentences.en: Congress may have viewed them as such, SEC or the FCC, CFPB, the whole alphabet soup.
sentences.zh: 国会可能曾将它们视作独立机构，比如证监会、联邦通信委员会、消费者金融保护局，这一大堆字母缩写机构。

sentences.en: But that is not something that the Constitution understands.
sentences.zh: 但这并不是宪法所理解的概念。

sentences.en: The whole notion of an independent agency should be thrown out.
sentences.zh: 独立机构的整个概念都应该被抛弃。

sentences.en: I think we would see independent agencies completely beholden to the White House or not existing at all.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们会看到独立机构完全听命于白宫，或者根本不复存在。

sentences.en: But we would also see the powers distributed really differently between the three branches of government with so much more power seated in the president, where any kind of program,
sentences.zh: 但我们也将看到政府三个分支之间的权力分配发生真正意义上的巨大变化，更多的权力集中在总统手中，任何类型的项目——

sentences.en: whether it's social, scientific, environmental, no longer relies on that approval by Congress, but really depends forever on whether or not the president wants it to happen.
sentences.zh: 无论是社会、科学还是环境项目——不再依赖国会的批准，而是永远取决于总统是否希望它发生。

sentences.en: We would see a fundamentally remade three branches of government with a lot more power and authority in the executive and less checks and balances in the other two.
sentences.zh: 我们将看到一个彻底重塑的政府三权分立体制，行政部门拥有更多的权力和权威，而其他两个部门的制衡则会减少。

sentences.en: I guess I'm wondering whether as vote progresses toward that goal, there's a world in which it starts to backfire on him.
sentences.zh: 我想我在想，随着沃特向这个目标推进，会不会出现一个开始对他产生反噬的世界。

sentences.en: As he and the administration move to fire thousands of workers, for example, during the shutdown to slash spending at this time,
sentences.zh: 例如，当他和政府在政府关门期间采取行动解雇成千上万的员工以大幅削减开支时，

sentences.en: you'd expect to see a negative economic impact, right?
sentences.zh: 你预计会看到负面的经济影响，对吧？

sentences.en: The government is one of the biggest employers in the country.
sentences.zh: 政府是该国最大的雇主之一。

sentences.en: And you've told us Trump isn't as bought in as vote is on shrinking the government from a philosophical standpoint.
sentences.zh: 而且你告诉过我们，从哲学角度来看，特朗普对精简政府的投入程度并不像沃特那么深。

sentences.en: So if this plan becomes politically costly for Trump, might that lead to the president abandoning vote's vision?
sentences.zh: 因此，如果这个计划对特朗普来说在政治上代价高昂，这会不会导致总统放弃沃特的愿景？

sentences.en: That is the big question, is what will the political and economic fallout of this look like?
sentences.zh: 这才是最大的问题，这一切将带来怎样的政治和经济余波？

sentences.en: I think the man driving the train right now is driven by radical ideological fire and ultimate preparation.
sentences.zh: 我认为现在驱动这辆列车的人，其动力来自激进的意识形态之火和终极的筹备。

sentences.en: But what will happen when the safety net is taken away, when jobs are lost, when people really feel this?
sentences.zh: 但是，当安全网被抽走、当工作岗位丢失、当人们真正感受到这一点时，将会发生什么？

sentences.en: When the rubber hits the road.
sentences.zh: 也就是见真章的时候。

sentences.en: Yeah, I do think there is also a bet from the White House that voters will like this, that voters will want to see government drawn back and removed from their lives.
sentences.zh: 是的，我也认为白宫内部存在这样一种押注：选民会喜欢这样，选民会希望看到政府规模缩减并从他们的生活中退出。

sentences.en: That's what vote wants to see.
sentences.zh: 这正是沃特希望看到的。

sentences.en: I think that if Americans realize they don't like that and that there is a tremendous backlash to the pulling back of all these safety nets,
sentences.zh: 我认为，如果美国人意识到他们并不喜欢这样，并且对所有这些安全网的撤回存在巨大的强烈反对，

sentences.en: that Trump himself could get cold feet and walk this vision back and that vote might not get what he wants.
sentences.zh: 那么特朗普本人可能会临阵退缩并收回这个愿景，而沃特可能无法如愿以偿。

sentences.en: You know, we'll see what the political fallout looks like.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们将拭目以待政治余波会是什么样子。

sentences.en: Well, Coral, thanks so much.
sentences.zh: 好的，科拉，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you, Natalie.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，娜塔莉。

sentences.en: It was great to be here, as always.
sentences.zh: 一如既往，很高兴来到这里。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: Israel and Hamas are set to begin a new round of negotiations in Egypt on Monday, where the two sides, speaking through Egyptian and Qatari mediators,
sentences.zh: 以色列和哈马斯定于周一在埃及开始新一轮谈判，双方将通过埃及和卡塔尔斡旋人转达意见，

sentences.en: will discuss President Trump's proposal for ending the war in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 讨论特朗普总统关于结束加沙战争的提议。

sentences.en: They're expected to focus on the potential release of all Israeli hostages in exchange for Palestinian prisoners.
sentences.zh: 预计他们的重点将是释放所有以色列人质以换取巴勒斯坦囚犯的可能性。

sentences.en: On Friday, Hamas said in a statement that it agreed to Trump's framework for returning to Israel all living hostages and the bodies of those who had died.
sentences.zh: 周五，哈马斯在一份声明中表示，它同意特朗普关于向以色列归还所有活着的人质以及死者遗体的框架。

sentences.en: But the militant group left many questions unanswered, including whether it agreed to the White House demand that it be barred from political power in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 但这个激进组织留下了许多未解的问题，包括它是否同意白宫关于禁止其在加沙掌握政治权力的要求。

sentences.en: Trump told the news site Axios that he'll push to finalize a peace deal between the two sides in the next few days.
sentences.zh: 特朗普对新闻网站Axios表示，他将推动在接下来几天内敲定双方之间的和平协议。
